newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF sells 51 pct Kali&Salz stake to PCS.
newsitem.headline: BASF sells 51 pct Kali&Salz stake to PCS.

text.p: German chemicals group BASF AG on Monday said its subsidiary Guano-Werke GmbH has sold a 51 percent stake in Kali und Salz Beteiligungs AG to the Canadian group Potash Corporation of Saskatechewan (PCS) for 250 million marks.

BASF still holds 25.4 percent of Kali und Salz, a German potash mine owner and operator. PCS, a leading producer of fertilisers, has a call option to purchase the remaining stake at any time before January 1, 2000 for 124.8 million marks.
Meanwhile the German bourse said it had suspended trading in Kali und Salz.
Cartel officials still need to approve the deal and BASF expects the sale to be closed in the first quarter 1997.
BASF announced plans to sell the stake to PCS in the late summer.
PCS said it plans to fund the purchase of the shares with cash obtained from either its existing cash or borrowing under its existing credit facility.
